{{Quote|The Grans did not "subjugate" the Dugs of Malastare. We delivered them from their poverty and primitive ways. Nor are they "slaves". They are indentured servants, working off their debt to the Gran government.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 14">[[Star Wars (1998) 14|''Star Wars'' (1998) 14]]</ref>}}
The '''Gran Protectorate''' was a government established on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colonists c. [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].

==History==
It was established after a series of [[Dug-Gran conflict|conflicts]] between the Gran and the native [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]]; after the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sided in favor of the Gran, the Protectorate [[Gran Protectorate Act/Legends|was established]] and resettled the Dugs to the [[Malastare's western continent|western continent]] of their homeworld.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The Gran Protectorate, while maintaining the Gran's strong social bonds, operated under a much looser set of moral codes than those that governed the Gran on their homeworld, [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. Partially because of this, corruption was extremely high. The high corruption rate, as well as the brutality towards the Dugs, led some Gran on Kinyen to conclude that the Gran of Malastare were no longer real Gran.

[[File:GranProtectorate-SWREP14.jpg|thumb|250ox|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Yeesrim]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Teem]] of the Gran Protectorate]]

The Protectorate soon became the most influential and powerful of all Gran settlements. In the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], all of Malastare's [[Senator/Legends|senators]] (such as [[Pax Teem]], [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]], [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]], [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]], and [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]]) came from the Protectorate.
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Protectorate appeared to have at least ceded self-rule to
a predominantly Dug [[Malastarian council/Legends|Malastarian council]] under [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]] which ratified the [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|Treaty of Malastare]] with the Republic following the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] and the apparent death of the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]].<ref name="Zillo Beast">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

The Protectorate was presumably weakened, or possibly even abolished, under first the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] (where the planet was ruled by [[Human/Legends|Humans]])<ref name="The Force Unleashed novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] (where Dugs appeared to have equal rights). In any event, the Protectorate was certainly destroyed when Malastare was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
